title: A Storm in the Mountains
text:
In the summer, a strong storm hit a small town in the mountains. The wind was very fast, and heavy rain fell for three hours. Many trees fell down, and some roads were closed.

The people in the town helped each other after the storm. Neighbors cleaned the streets and shared food. The local school became a safe place for families who lost their homes.

questions.text: What hit the small town in the summer?
What did the neighbors do after the storm?
options: They cleaned the streets and shared food
People did not want to travel

questions.text: Why did the school become important after the storm?
options: It was the tallest building in town
It was the only school in the mountains
It gave a safe place to families who lost their homes

vocabulary.definition: very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain
groups of parents and children who live together
gave part of something to other people to use

paragraph_translations: Latem silna burza uderzyła w małe miasteczko w górach. Wiatr był bardzo silny, a intensywny deszcz padał przez trzy godziny. Wiele drzew zostało przewróconych, a niektóre drogi zostały zamknięte.
Ludzie w miasteczku po burzy pomagali sobie nawzajem. Sąsiedzi sprzątali ulice i dzielili się jedzeniem. Lokalna szkoła stała się bezpiecznym miejscem dla rodzin, które straciły domy.
